title: Jonah and the Plant
reflectionText: A vine came up in a night and perished in a night, and Jonah cared more for its shade than for a city of a hundred twenty thousand. Twice God asked whether his anger was right. The book ends before Jonah answers. Have you ever been left holding God's question about Nineveh, and all those people who cannot discern between their right hand and their left hand?
editorialNotes: PAL Daily supervised production 2026-08-01, Batch I. Owner-approved anchor Jonah 4, whole chapter, no verses excluded. Written as the CODA to 1100 (Jonah 3, Nineveh repents), not as a middle beat: the single opening clause 'The city was spared' is neutral connective narration re-anchoring the referent of verse 1's 'it' for a listener, and the repentance of Nineveh is not re-told. Ends on God's question, unanswered, as the chapter does. WEB 'vine' and 'Yahweh'; KJV 'gourd' and 'the Lord'. Journey backlog item G16. TEXT APPROVED — AUDIO AUTHORIZED BY OWNER ON 2026-08-01.
